subject: PROGRAM-ID paragraph
notes: Program-name-1 and literal-1 are separate fields (BoundUnit.Name / BoundUnit.ExternalizedName), and 8.3.2.2 makes the split observable in both directions: CALL by the AS literal reaches the program while END PROGRAM names the declared word, and FUNCTION MODULE-NAME reports the declared word (docs/CONFORMANCE.md DOC-A.1-135). Before kb/Work PB303 the two were one field AND the phrase had no grammar surface.
